title: CheckRequest::parse documents 'INPUT_INVALID when body is not a check request', but every non-own serde failure, including Data shape errors
description: CheckRequest::parse documents 'INPUT_INVALID when body is not a check request', but every non-own serde failure, including Data shape errors, returns ENCODE_FAILED. CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes does the same for Data versus other categories, so the two parsers split codes differently. In `parse`, the text computed by `describe` is discarded in the non-own branch and the error is rebuilt with `encode_failed`.
